_readme: Exposure decisions for the tool parity audit (scripts/tool-parity.mjs). Every tool visible on either surface (MCP bridge / playground agent) must be recorded here as 'gap' (absence is a defect to fix) or 'deliberate' (absence is design, with the reason). Unannotated tools fail `bun run tool:parity --check`. Seeded from docs/design/TOOL-SYSTEM.md's exposure matrix.

switch_auth_identity.reason: MCP bridge verb-first identity switching tool; Playground switches identity through its session UI and auth controls

manage_auth_users.reason: MCP bridge verb-first Auth user administration tool; Playground seeds and inspects its own session pool with seed_auth_users / inspect_auth_users

inspect_auth_flow.reason: MCP bridge outbox mail and session inspection tool; Playground inspects session state directly

mutate_sandbox_data.reason: MCP bridge atomic data mutation tool for Firestore and Realtime Database; Playground uses its native session workspace

query_sandbox_data.reason: MCP bridge structured query tool for Firestore and Realtime Database; Playground uses its native session workspace

manage_storage_files.reason: MCP bridge Cloud Storage object management tool; Playground manages storage files through its workspace tools

diagnose_rule_denial.reason: MCP bridge AST-level security rules denial tracer; Playground reaches denial tracing through its native diagnostic tools

verify_security_rules.reason: MCP bridge rules linter, module resolver, and suite simulator; Playground verifies rules inside its authoring workflow

dry_run_experiment.reason: MCP bridge copy-on-write sandbox branching and traffic regression verifier; external agent workflow

control_sandbox_environment.reason: MCP bridge environment control (reset_all, clock advance, network toggle); external agent workflow

invoke_cloud_function.reason: MCP bridge callable/event Cloud Function invocation tool; external agent workflow

configure_ai_mock.reason: MCP bridge deterministic AI scripting and mock configuration tool; external agent workflow

pyric_can_i_use.reason: Shared MCP and Playground trust query; the CLI/MCP retain full claims while the browser receives only the measured compact projection

build_game_rules.reason: Playground skill-specific authoring workflow, activated only by its skill; not a general MCP primitive

debug_firestore_rules.reason: Playground orchestration wrapper; external agents compose the MCP rules and inspection primitives directly

firestore_extract_indexes.reason: artifact generation is exposed through `pyric firestore indexes generate`; external agents can invoke the CLI without a duplicate MCP tool

firestore_rules_stdlib_get.reason: intentionally shared rules-authoring reference across MCP and Playground

firestore_rules_stdlib_list.reason: intentionally shared rules-authoring reference across MCP and Playground

rules_stdlib_get.reason: service-aware rules-authoring reference intentionally shared across MCP and Playground

rules_stdlib_list.reason: service-aware rules-authoring reference intentionally shared across MCP and Playground

inspect_auth_users.reason: Playground session-inspection affordance; the default MCP contract currently exposes only ratified attached-sandbox tool families

run_workspace_tests.reason: Playground virtual-workspace operation; external agents run project tests through their native shell

sandbox_discover_paths.reason: Playground session-navigation affordance; MCP already exposes bounded list, query, and inspect primitives

seed_auth_users.reason: Playground fixture convenience; external MCP sessions operate on the attached application sandbox rather than a parallel seed API

seed_firestore_data_as_admin.reason: Playground fixture convenience; MCP exposes explicit Firestore create and batch operations instead

inspect_firestore_traffic.reason: missing from MCP — an external agent debugging rules needs the same visibility the playground agent has

inspect_denial.reason: missing from MCP — the killer feature must be reachable from Claude Code

try_rules_edit.reason: missing from MCP — rules iteration from an external agent is a core story

generate_fixture_from_session.reason: missing from MCP — pairs with `pyric verify`, an external-agent workflow

simulate_firestore_write.reason: ok per TOOL-SYSTEM.md — exposed via bridge rules tools (firestore_simulate_rules) and the playground diagnostic; verify arg parity between the two implementations

list_files.reason: workspace file tool, playground-only — external agents have their own filesystem; exposing a second one invites split-brain

search_file.reason: workspace file tool, playground-only — external agents have their own filesystem; exposing a second one invites split-brain

read_file.reason: workspace file tool, playground-only — external agents have their own filesystem; exposing a second one invites split-brain

edit_file.reason: workspace file tool, playground-only — external agents have their own filesystem; exposing a second one invites split-brain

write_file.reason: workspace file tool, playground-only — external agents have their own filesystem; exposing a second one invites split-brain

delete_file.reason: workspace file tool, playground-only — external agents have their own filesystem; exposing a second one invites split-brain

bash.reason: VFS shell, playground-only — same reason as the workspace file tools; external agents have their own shell

workspace_checkpoints.reason: session-workspace concern, playground-only — external agents use real git

workspace_git.reason: session-workspace concern, playground-only — external agents use real git

github_create_repo.reason: session-workspace publish flow, playground-only — external agents use real git/GitHub directly

github_push_branch.reason: session-workspace publish flow, playground-only — external agents use real git/GitHub directly

github_create_pull_request.reason: session-workspace publish flow, playground-only — external agents use real git/GitHub directly
